corrections: Phase VI drew one trunk per path; each H6a path is a supply + return pair (4 trunks per blade)
findings: Per blade: 2,765 kg/s Li, 1990 K out and 1690 K back, trunks D 0.75 m at 10 m/s, p max 1.64 MPa, pumps 3.4 MW.

Trunks outside the hull at r 6.52 m flanking the blade root (0.35 m off the hull); they reach 0.40 m up the blade root (1.3 % of the 30.5 m width) and partly shade the next metres (view factor: Stage E, radiators3d.py); the heat-pipe fins (13.9 t) belong to the blade and are not drawn.
Valves 34 per blade (model 34), bellows 30 (model 30): the drawn network matches the mass model counts.
EM pumps 7.5 t each: above the 3 t ORU limit.
Supports (PSA HO-01): 4 saddles per 25.4 m section (pitch 6.4 m), one axial anchor each; trunk 0.211 t/m, 5.4 t per saddle, anchor 155 kN per section at 0.74 g; section-end travel +-38 to +-127 mm.

supports.note: axial loads go to the mid-section anchor in burns; slides carry only radial/lateral loads (no spin, no gravity in coast); growth 3 mm/m (FT-01 composite, CTE ~2e-6/K) to 10 mm/m (bellows bound)
